tests.objective: Full platform runs M1 -> gate -> M2 -> M3 as one governed pass from the single canonical path, producing a structured report with zero fabrications.
tests.scenario: GIVEN the full CodeTruth platform and a real repository, WHEN it is run in one governed pass (M1 -> gate -> M2 -> M3), THEN the pipeline completes end-to-end, the gate is a real decision, structure is scanned, and reasoning fabricates nothing.
tests.expected_result: status=COMPLETE; gate in {APPROVED, REVIEW_REQUIRED}; M1 emits an identity; M2 scans >=1 file; M3 guesses=0.

checks.name: m1_produced_identity
checks.expected: module1 has non-empty application_type and framework

tests.objective: Module 1 alone understands the repository: emits a governance decision and a non-empty identity with bounded confidence.
tests.scenario: GIVEN only Module 1 and a repository, WHEN cognition runs, THEN it produces a governance decision and a non-empty identity (application type, framework, architecture) with a bounded confidence - with no downstream modules involved.
tests.expected_result: status=COMPLETE; gate in {APPROVED, REVIEW_REQUIRED, BLOCKED}; identity fields non-empty; confidence in [0,1]. (Identity CORRECTNESS is out of scope - Phase 2.)

tests.objective: Module 2 alone builds a structural model: scans files and returns a governance gate and COMPLETE status (Python).
tests.scenario: GIVEN only Module 2 and a Python repository, WHEN the structural scan runs, THEN it parses files and returns a governance gate and a COMPLETE status.
tests.expected_result: status=COMPLETE; governance_gate set (not UNKNOWN); files_scanned>0. (Graph MAGNITUDES are informational - the runner return is thin by contract.)

tests.objective: Module 3 alone reasons over structure: produces phase 3A/3B results with zero guesses and no fabricated confidence.
tests.scenario: GIVEN only Module 3 and a repository, WHEN reasoning runs, THEN it produces phase 3A and 3B results and holds the Truth Boundary - declining what it cannot verify rather than guessing.
tests.expected_result: phase_3a and phase_3b present; truth_boundary.guesses=0; numeric_confidence_scores=0; 3A reports resolved/baseline. (3A COVERAGE %% is informational, not a pass criterion.)
